title: Doggy Style
description: A playful photo series of man’s best friend, capturing humor, movement, and the unique personality of dogs within the urban environment.

images.alt: Woman walking a dog carrying a stick across a covered pedestrian bridge
Small white dog straining at a long leash on a snowy slope beside its owner
Dog trotting past a gate as a car blurs behind it
Woman in a mustard knit hat with a small dog framed between black bollards
Small dog resting its chin on a curved balcony ledge beneath pussy willow branches
Black dog running through shallow water with a stick
Dog in a coat sniffing a woman's boot beside a shop window
White dog leaping in the water toward a tennis ball
Small brown dog on a leash walking along a sunny sidewalk
